topic: Three things to check on a daily mining payout
title: 3 Things to Check on Your Daily Mining Payout
hook: Three things to check on every daily mining payout.

scenes.narration: See the daily pool reward credited to your miner.
See the electricity and service fees taken off it.
Check any discount applied, since terms can change.
Net reward is the number to keep an eye on, because it is what is left after costs.

cta: Which do you check first? Tell me in the comments, and the link is on my channel page.
description_body: Gross reward, deductions and discounts: the three lines behind your net payout.

sources.title: GoMining docs: maintenance fees and discounts
